a.
2027 Waste Collection Contract Extension and Future Procurement, Environmental Services-2026-19
1.
2027 Waste Collection Extension and Future Procurement - Environmental Services-2026-19.pdf
The Municipality’s current Agreement with Bruce Area Solid Waste Recycling (BASWR) expires on December 31, 2026. Administration requested a one-year extension agreement to maintain continuity of residential waste and cardboard collection during 2027.
KPMG has completed the business case for the proposed transition of BASWR to a Municipal Services Corporation (MSC), and Council endorsed proceeding with this model in principle in July 2026. Further work is currently underway to establish the legal and governance framework and implement the new corporate structure.
The one-year extension allows this work to advance before the Municipality undertakes a competitive Request for Proposals (RFP) for future waste collection services. Once the procurement is initiated, BASWR is expected to be better positioned to participate under the proposed MSC structure. The RFP would also allow the Municipality to evaluate its longer-term service requirements, including potential wheeled-bin collection and a Green Bin
program.
Motion #
That Administration report back in the first quarter of 2027 with an update on the proposed BASWR Municipal Services Corporation (MSC) transition and a proposed scope and timeline for a competitive Request for Proposals for future waste collection services.
b.
Lakeside Radio Broadcasting Lease, Environmental Services-2026-21
1.
Lakeside Radio Broadcasting Lease  - Environmental Services-2026-21.pdf
2.
2026-11-04 - Lakeside Radio Agreement.pdf
The Municipality of Kincardine has had a long-standing agreement with Lakeside Radio Broadcasting Corp. which includes the placement of antennas on the Kincardine Water Tower, and installation of communication equipment within the property parcel at that site.
Both parties have reviewed the Lease Agreement and are proposing to sign a five-year Agreement for continued service.
Motion #
That Council pass a By-law to approve a five-year Agreement with Lakeside Radio Broadcasting Corp., for the period of January 1, 2027, to December 31, 2031.
